build_failure_banner

The `BUILD FAILURE` / `FAILURE: Build failed` banner Maven and Gradle print once the build gave up.

jvmbuildwrappermatcher

Open in playgroundFile on GitHubHistory

Install: ci-doctor matchers add official/build_failure_banner

matchers/jvm/build_failure_banner/matcher.yaml

id: build_failure_banner
role: wrapper
classification: [jvm, build]
description: 'The `BUILD FAILURE` / `FAILURE: Build failed` banner Maven and Gradle print once the build gave up.'
pattern: 'FAILURE: Build failed|BUILD FAILURE'
before: 3
after: 15

In bundles

alljvm
